events.heading: Teaching Clinic
events.description:
Education is the key to addressing many of the world's most pressing issues. Our Teaching Clinic is a place where dedicated volunteers come together to empower secondary school students with the knowledge and skills they need for a brighter future. We believe in promoting quality education (SDG 4) and nurturing the talents of our local youth.

We don't just teach academic knowledge; we also instill life skills and values that will shape these students into well-rounded individuals ready to tackle the challenges of tomorrow.

By participating in Teaching Clinic, we become part of a global effort to make a real impact in our community.

Don't miss this opportunity to get involved and learn how you can contribute to a better future for all. Join us here to discover more about our Teaching Clinic and become a part of our mission to empower, educate, and achieve the SDGs.

events.heading: Book Drive
events.description:
SDA Book Drive is an initiative born out of the need to provide books to less privileged schools and students, thus promoting reading culture in Nigerian students and enhancing the culture of giving back. It is carried out through periodic calls to students and the general public to contribute educational materials like textbooks, academic stationery and new notebooks to students lacking access to them.

Through our Book Drive project, we aim to support quality education (SDG 4) as we believe strongly, quality education should be accessible to all.

Interested in joining this cause? Kindly contact use via SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT ADVOCATES to discuss donation options or alternative methods to support this cause.

events.heading: SDGsEd
events.description:
Sustainable Development Goals Education (SDGsEd) is a bimonthly educational webinar aimed at enlightening the public on emerging technologies and highlighting the ways in which various sectors and skill sets work together to advance the SDGs.

At SDGsEd, highly skilled and venerated individuals, who are advancing the SDGs in various sectors with exceptional strategies, are invited to speak on carefully selected topics. This is done in order to close knowledge gaps and make lasting impact.

The next SDGsEd is coming up on the 25th of May, 2024. To catch up on these sessions, click here.

events.heading: Investiture Ceremony
events.description: The investiture ceremony is a mandatory induction event for all new SDA members and its incoming executive team, taking place before the commencement of each new SDA calendar. It serves as the last event in the induction process which initiates with a two-week interim class where potential SDA members get acquainted with the SDGs and the club's fundamental principles.

events.heading: SDA Teaching Clinic
events.description:
The SDA Teaching Clinic is an SDGs-based project, which was born out of the need to provide quality education through the supply of tutors by the organization to Bright Archivers Schools at Ilaje Bariga.

Teaching Clinic was launched as an offset of the 'Save The Lagoon' project, through which advocates embarked upon advocating against ocean pollution through massive advocacy at the Illaje, Bariga. Bright Achievers School was one of the advocacy points. The clubs observed the lack of teachers at the school, despite the growing population of students. Thus was the nascence of the 'Teaching Clinic'.

Since 2022, the club has supplied tutors to the above-mentioned school.

How To Get Involved
SDA is working towards providing more permanent tutors in the following sections in the Senior School: Sciences: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Further Mathematics, English, Biology, Agricultural Sciences, amongst othersArts: French, Literature in English, English Language, MathematicsCommercial: Government, Economics, English Language, Mathematics, etc.

events.heading: Training and Preparatory Classes for Millennium Fellowship Applicants
events.description:
Millennium Fellowship is a semester-long social impact program by the United Nations Academic Impact (UNAI) in conjunction with the Millennium Campus Network, where successful applicants are convened, challenged, and celebrated for the various impacts they make.

SDA prides itself on having the highest number of successful applicants and producing campus directors for each cohort of all student organizations in the University of Lagos since 2019, thus producing over 30-millennium fellows and counting.

SDA applicants are guided throughout the application process, with successful fellows being mentored throughout the fellowship for maximum impact and result delivery. Meet the Fellows: (Link to pictures and bio of their projects)

events.heading: Town Hall Meeting
events.description: SDA town hall meeting is a monthly in-person that brings both club members and alumni together to exchange ideas on the way forward for the club. These gatherings serve as pivotal platforms to evaluate performance, present executive reports on activities and finances, discuss member concerns across past, present, and future endeavors, and acknowledge exceptional contributions.
